kernelsu_next.why_this_fork: Official KernelSU-Next legacy source pinned to the upstream revision above. The in-tree compatibility overlay restores SuSFS v2.3.0 integration for this non-GKI 4.14 port; manual host hooks are adapted to the upstream two-UID setresuid API. NoMount remains a separate built-in component.
kernelsu_next.local_modifications: SuSFS v2.3.0 compatibility overlay, 4.14 manual-hook API integration, and workflow version overrides; upstream source is otherwise synced from the pinned commit.

susfs.why_this_patch: simonpunk/susfs4ksu officially stops at v1.5.1; v2.3.0 legacy support for 4.14 comes from this community port, which is what the non-GKI guides (and the reference kernels in this family) apply.
susfs.userspace_requirement: ksu_susfs v2.x helper (susfs4ksu module >= 2.3.0). v1.5.x 'susfs4ksu.sh' is incompatible: add_open_redirect() gained a third <UID_SCHEME> argument.

nomount.integration: kernel/README.md 'Option A: build-in', kernel/src/* copied verbatim
nomount.why_builtin: legacy kernels (<5.10) cannot load the release's prebuilt LKMs
nomount.userspace_requirement: NoMount metamodule (nm CLI over the kernel keyring, add_key(2) based; no ioctl device node)

ebpf.requirement: 5.10-level eBPF backport present; add patches only if missing
ebpf.verdict: requirement already met - no eBPF changes made
present: kernel/bpf: btf.c core.c verifier.c syscall.c dispatcher.c trampoline.c bpf_struct_ops.c bpf_lsm.c ringbuf.c bpf_iter.c task_iter.c prog_iter.c map_iter.c bpf_local_storage.c bpf_inode_storage.c local_storage.c preload.c offload.c sysfs_btf.c disasm.c
ebpf.reason_for_no_changes: Absent features are all post-5.10; backporting them onto the 4.14 bpf_prog/btf/trampoline layout is a large risky surgery unrelated to the root stack. See docs/root-integration.md#ebpf.

non_gki_patches.status: not applicable: net/netfilter/xt_qtaguid.c is absent from this tree

compatibility_notes: WALT prevents CONFIG_CFS_BANDWIDTH from being enabled in this kernel; DroidSpaces CPU quotas may be unavailable.
The tree uses CONFIG_NF_CT_NETLINK in place of the guide name CONFIG_NF_CONNTRACK_NETLINK.

The guide names CONFIG_NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_MASQUERADE, CONFIG_FW_LOADER_COMPRESS, and CONFIG_ANDROID_PARANOID_NETWORK, which are not Kconfig symbols here; family NAT targets are enabled and FW_LOADER_USER_HELPER is enabled.

toolchain.gcc: not used for the kernel; no GNU cross binutils installed by CI

note: KernelSU-Next kernel/ and uapi/ are synced to the pinned official upstream commit; the KSU SusFS overlay and host manual hooks are local integration changes. All vendored source is committed in-tree for offline reproducibility.
